mcp_tools_source: runtime stdio tools/list via scripts/mcphub/scrapling-stdio.sh @scrapling[ai]==0.4.10 (MCP serverInfo version 1.28.1); bounded registry subset cross-checked against tests/test_scrapling_registry.py

risk_notes: Browser tools spawn Chromium; CPU/RAM heavy

dedupe_summary: Complements fetch, fetcher, trafilatura with CSS-selector extraction and anti-bot fetch; not a harness default replacement for chrome-devtools
